identity.name: EduFlow
identity.tone: Modern, Approachable, Organized, Academic but Fresh

typography.installation: Import fonts via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Outfit:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Public+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap');

usage_rules.gradients: Avoid full-screen gradients. Use subtle mesh gradients in hero sections only: 'bg-gradient-to-br from-sky-50 to-white'.
usage_rules.text_contrast: Never use pure black (#000000). Use Slate-900 (#0F172A) for headings and Slate-600 (#475569) for body text.

spacing_system.base: Use 2x standard spacing. If you think p-4 is enough, use p-8.

grid_strategies.landing_page: Mode A: The Tetris Grid. Asymmetrical layouts. Use col-span-full for hero, col-span-4 for features. Never equal 3-column grids.
grid_strategies.dashboard: Mode B: High Density Grid. grid-cols-12. Sidebar col-span-2, Main Content col-span-10. Widgets: col-span-3, col-span-6, col-span-4. Use h-full to stretch cards.

containers.card_style: bg-white border border-slate-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200 rounded-xl
containers.dashboard_card: bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-none rounded-lg p-6

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-lg shadow-primary/20 rounded-full px-8 py-6 font-semibold tracking-wide transition-transform active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 hover:border-slate-300 rounded-full px-8 py-6 font-medium
buttons.ghost: text-slate-600 hover:text-primary hover:bg-sky-50 rounded-lg px-4 py-2

inputs.style: bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 focus:border-primary focus:ring-4 focus:ring-primary/10 rounded-lg h-12 px-4 text-base transition-all

cards.landing: group relative overflow-hidden bg-white border border-slate-100 rounded-2xl p-8 hover:border-primary/20 transition-colors
cards.dashboard: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6 flex flex-col gap-4

navigation.header: sticky top-0 z-50 w-full border-b border-slate-100 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl supports-[backdrop-filter]:bg-white/60
navigation.sidebar: fixed left-0 top-0 z-40 h-screen w-64 border-r border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/50 backdrop-blur-xl

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border border-white/20 shadow-sm' for floating elements like toasts or sticky headers.
visual_enhancers.noise_texture: Add a subtle noise texture overlay to the body background at 2% opacity to reduce digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: All interactive elements must have 'active:scale-95' or 'hover:-translate-y-1' transitions.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Use colored shadows for primary actions: 'shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(14,165,233,0.15)]'.

media.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all UI icons. Stroke width: 1.5px for a refined look.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text-slate-600 or darker on white backgrounds.
accessibility.focus_states: All interactive elements must have visible focus rings: 'focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary'.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. Configure tailwind.config.js with the provided color palette and border radius.
3. Create a 'Layout' component that handles the sidebar/header structure for dashboards.
4. Use the 'Tetris Grid' for the landing page - do not make it a simple list of sections.
5. Ensure all forms use 'react-hook-form' and 'zod' for validation (standard practice).
7. Implement the 'High Density Grid' for the dashboard - minimize whitespace between widgets, maximize data visibility.
8. DO NOT use gradients for text. Keep text solid Slate-900.
9. Use the provided image URLs for specific sections. Do not use placeholders.
